name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a requested time interval. All times (start, end, now, and bookings) are whole minutes since midnight in the range 0-1440 (where 0 is 00:00 and 1440 is 24:00). This tool only checks availability and does not save, create, or modify any booking.

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked for maintenance or administrative hold.

bookings.description: List of existing bookings for the room, each with start and end in whole minutes since midnight.
